meta.name: shadcn
meta.description: Manages shadcn components and projects — adding, searching, fixing, debugging, styling, and composing UI, including chat interfaces. Provides project context, component docs, and usage examples. Applies when working with shadcn/ui, component registries, presets, --preset codes, or any project with a components.json file. Also triggers for "shadcn init", "create an app with --preset", or "switch to --preset".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 管理 shadcn 组件和项目，添加、搜索、修复、调试和组合 UI
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果使用 shadcn/ui 构建 React 界面，需要管理组件和项目配置
copy.tagline_en: Manage shadcn components and projects: add, search, fix, debug, and compose UI
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you build React UIs with shadcn/ui and need to manage components and project config

howto.what: 装上后，你在做 shadcn/ui 项目时，Claude 会帮你管理组件：添加、查找、修复、调试、改样式、组合界面（包括聊天界面）。它会先读取项目配置和组件文档，再按规则写出或修改代码。
howto.when: 当你在处理 shadcn/ui 组件或注册表、输入“shadcn init”，或请求用 --preset 创建/切换项目时触发；项目中存在 components.json 也会触发。

say.text: 帮我添加一个 Button 组件
say.note: 会检查是否已安装，再用 CLI 添加。

say.text: 把设置页改成 Tabs 加 Card 的布局
用这个 preset 代码重新初始化项目
say.note: 会执行 init --preset 并询问覆盖方式。

howto.what_en: With this skill, when working on shadcn/ui projects, Claude handles components — adding, searching, fixing, debugging, styling and composing UI (including chat). It reads project config and docs first, then writes or updates code following the rules.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you work with shadcn/ui components or registries, run "shadcn init", or ask to create/switch with --preset; also applies to any project with a components.json file.

say_en.text: Add a Button component for me.
say_en.note: Checks if it's installed, then adds via CLI.

say_en.text: Refactor the settings page to use Tabs plus Card.
Reinitialize the project with this preset code.
say_en.note: Runs init --preset and asks how to overwrite.
